verdict.rationale: CIPO's own trademarks page lists "Apply for/amend a trademark" under an Online services block, and the patents page routes filing through a "Log in to MyCIPO Patents" account. Together these point to online filing of the core transaction. However, the evidence shows only the entry points: it never states that an application, including payment of fees, can be submitted and completed end-to-end online. Other core transactions (industrial design, copyright registration, patent maintenance fees) appear only as link titles, with no online-completion statement. missing for 10: explicit published statement that filing and fee payment complete fully online, online-completion evidence for patents/industrial designs/copyright, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: "Apply for/amend a trademark" sits under an Online services block on the office's own trademarks page
"Log in to MyCIPO Patents" is the published entry
